info.name: Workday Security Workday Audit and Compliance Account Signons Security Group Members API
Workday Security List members of a security group

params.name: securityGroupId
params.description: Unique identifier of the security group

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieve the collection of users and integration system users that are members of the specified security group. Returns member details including account information and assignment metadata.
